annotations.title: Revert a Playground agent run’s canvas changes

description: Undo every canvas change one agent run made, newest first, as one new revision. If someone has edited those nodes since, nothing changes and the conflicting node/edge IDs are returned; pass force=true only after confirming the later edits may be discarded. Generated media and credits are not refunded by a revert. Returns revert status, revision and any conflicting or overridden changes.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

force.description: Whether to override detected conflicts while reverting; use only when the user intends to overwrite those later changes.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

runId.description: Run ID returned by preparation or execution for this project.
